publication: Only accepted implementation changes to existing feature branches; preserve failed candidates in existing evidence branches; no merging

nine.change: Store active memory-recording offsets in one compact vector, avoiding repeated full-mask gather/scatter
nine.controls: Tiny recorders, empty and unknown accesses; public frontend vector/softmax with tracing both enabled and disabled
nine.primary_metric: MemoryRecorder capture/access time; recorder construction and fixture creation excluded; standalone recording layer, not total interpreter speed
nine.memory_metric: tracemalloc during one capture/access, excluding existing inputs and masks; no RSS claim

cuda.change: Two adjacent values per thread in explicit packed quantize-only paths for N=2/4/8/16; original, fused and N1 routes retained
cuda.controls: Small packed calls, N1 packed, original quantize and packed Hadamard/fused at N8
cuda.correctness: Independent finite-value CPU oracle, exhaustive finite encodings as selected pair components, midpoint/extreme/subnormal patterns, offsets and guards, tails, allocating/out, stream/graph, legacy validation
cuda.scope: NVIDIA extension explicit packed quantization only; existing CLI FWHT, Tensor Core, and other backend kernel code unchanged
cuda.primary_metric: Same-buffer CUDA event time over warmed 64-node graphs, ten replays; old packed implementation as baseline
cuda.secondary_metric: Synchronized ordinary allocating/out calls at 256 threads; require no case to regress beyond 5%
